inheritance_rule: all 38 wire fields outside the allowlist are byte-identical to the approved Frozen-FSM baseline vector (§8.2)

moderate.design_intent: epoch-mean hot/dry posture on the wire grid

cool_stage2_over_high_f.rationale: Second-stage cooling engages slightly earlier than default, matching observed practice.

sw_cool_all_fans_at_high_enabled.rationale: Majority-time posture ran both fans immediately above temp_high.

fog_escalation_kpa.evidence: §5 epoch mean 0.261 kPa (75.4% below the 0.4 kPa default); wire grid 0.1 kPa
fog_escalation_kpa.rationale: Earlier fog escalation than default; 0.3 is the nearest wire-grid value to the epoch mean.

min_fog_on_s.evidence: no §5 evidence of movement from the 60 s default
min_fog_on_s.rationale: Held at the compiled default; the observed epoch did not demonstrate a different posture.

min_fog_off_s.evidence: no §5 evidence of movement from the 60 s default
min_fog_off_s.rationale: Held at the compiled default; the observed epoch did not demonstrate a different posture.

mister_engage_kpa.evidence: §5 epoch mean 1.185 kPa (99.96% below the 1.6 kPa default); wire grid 0.05 kPa
mister_engage_kpa.rationale: Physical mister pulses engage well before the default threshold, matching observed practice.

mister_all_kpa.evidence: §5 epoch mean 1.360 kPa (99.99% below the 1.9 kPa default); wire grid 0.05 kPa
mister_all_kpa.rationale: All-zone rotation threshold near the epoch mean.

mister_all_delay_s.evidence: §5 epoch mean 87.3 s (>99.9% below the 300 s default); registry notes stress default 60-90 s
mister_all_delay_s.rationale: Short all-zone dwell consistent with the observed stress posture, on the 30 s operator step.

mister_pulse_gap_s.evidence: §5 epoch mean 37.6 s (69.9% below the 45 s default)
mister_pulse_gap_s.rationale: Slightly shorter evaporation dwell between zone pulses, matching observed practice.

mister_pulse_on_s.evidence: §5 posture table records no epoch mean shift; forecast response (+0.604 Pearson vs future max VPD) is plan-conditional
mister_pulse_on_s.rationale: Held at the compiled default; per-forecast lengthening belongs to the aggressive template.

mister_water_budget_gal.evidence: §5 epoch mean 222.4 gal (57.5% below the 300 gal default; never above)
mister_water_budget_gal.rationale: Lower total water ceiling with earlier response — the observed efficiency strategy.

aggressive.design_intent: bounded step further in the responsive hot/dry direction

cool_stage2_over_high_f.evidence: §5 Pearson −0.540 (stage-2 offset vs future max VPD): earlier second-stage cooling under load
cool_stage2_over_high_f.rationale: One bounded step earlier than the moderate 0.8°F; well inside the [0, 3]°F clamp.

sw_cool_all_fans_at_high_enabled.rationale: Both fans immediately above temp_high, as in the moderate template.

fog_escalation_kpa.evidence: §5 epoch mean 0.261 kPa already 75.4% below default
fog_escalation_kpa.rationale: One 0.1 kPa wire step earlier than moderate; stays above the 0.1 kPa clamp floor.

min_fog_on_s.evidence: §5: longer wet pulses under severe forecasts (mister pulse-on Pearson +0.604)
min_fog_on_s.rationale: Longer minimum fog runs once engaged, consistent with the longer-wet-pulse response direction.

min_fog_off_s.evidence: §5: shorter recovery gaps under severe forecasts (pulse-gap Pearson −0.596)
min_fog_off_s.rationale: Faster fog re-engagement during escalation; stays above the 15 s clamp floor.

mister_engage_kpa.evidence: §5 epoch mean 1.185 kPa; observed posture spent 99.96% of time below default
mister_engage_kpa.rationale: One bounded step earlier than moderate; twice the 0.5 kPa clamp floor.

mister_all_kpa.evidence: §5 epoch mean 1.360 kPa; registry notes keep it close to active vpd_high under hot/dry stress
mister_all_kpa.rationale: Earlier all-zone assist; stays above the 1.0 kPa clamp floor.

mister_all_delay_s.evidence: §5 epoch mean 87.3 s; registry stress default range 60-90 s
mister_all_delay_s.rationale: Fastest permitted all-zone rotation — exactly the 60 s firmware clamp floor the epoch already approached.

mister_pulse_gap_s.evidence: §5: shorter recovery gaps under severe forecasts (Pearson −0.596, partial −0.446)
mister_pulse_gap_s.rationale: One bounded step below the moderate 38 s; three times the 10 s clamp floor.

mister_pulse_on_s.evidence: §5: longer wet pulses under severe forecasts (Pearson +0.604, partial +0.493)
mister_pulse_on_s.rationale: Halfway between the 60 s default and the 90 s clamp ceiling.

mister_water_budget_gal.evidence: §5: more water headroom on severe forecasts (budget vs future max VPD Pearson +0.683)
mister_water_budget_gal.rationale: More headroom than moderate for severe hot/dry days while keeping a ceiling below the 300 gal default.
